newsitem.title: UK: Core Labs raises Scott Pickford bid.
newsitem.headline: Core Labs raises Scott Pickford bid.

text.p: U.S-based laboratory services group Core Laboratories NV said on Monday it raised its bid for British oil services company Scott Pickford Plc to 59 pence per share, valuing the company at around 7.5 million stg.

Core is fighting Australia's Aerodata Holdings for control of Scott Pickford. Core originally offered 53p per share but indicated it could be increased to 57p if a proposed share exchange with Aerodata did not go ahead. Aerodata had indicated a possible cash offer of 55p per share or equivalent value in its shares.

Core Labs said it would pay 55p in cash for every Scott Pickford share. That would be raised to 59p if Scott Pickford's board announced it would not proceed with the proposed share exchange with Aerodata.
Scott Pickford has proposed a dilutive share issue to Aerodata at 40p per share.

"Our increased offer is significantly higher than Aerodata's putative offer if the share exchange does not proceed. It would be in shareholders' best interests if the board were to recommend our increased offer," Core Labs president and chief executive offier David Demshur said in a statement.
